summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Laboratorio Dental Boss landing page. All 5 pytest backend tests passed. All critical UI flows (hero, navbar, service cards, booking form with success/error toasts, shadcn select, FAQ accordion, footer map, floating WhatsApp, mobile menu) work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In /app/backend/server.py, `logger` is referenced inside create_appointment (line 95) but defined at module-level at line 124. Works at runtime (logger lookup is deferred) but is a code-smell; move logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) above the route handlers for clarity.

Minor: create_appointment wraps everything in a broad try/except and masks Pydantic 422 validation exceptions into 500. Currently FastAPI validates payload BEFORE entering the handler so 422 still works, but any business-layer ValueError would be hidden. Consider catching only specific exceptions.
Note: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Not a problem for current public landing page but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_-prefixed appointments created in MongoDB during backend tests + 1 from UI test. Safe to leave or clean via collection drop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is fully functional. Backend endpoints POST/GET /api/appointments validated with Pydantic (422 on invalid), UUIDs returned, no _id leak. Frontend: BookingForm submits correctly, shadcn Select works (use page.get_by_role('option', name=...).click(force=True) for Radix portal items), toasts from sonner render at top-center. Mobile nav toggle data-testid='nav-mobile-toggle' opens panel data-testid='nav-mobile-panel'. WhatsApp number 525591694795 in all links (hero, nav, floating, contact section).
